messages:
joel_sales: Heads-up: AuroraFoil wants a quick POC next week to validate 'aurorafoil-20b-core' and a tight quant variant 'aurorafoil-20b-q4_2' for their edge orchestration. They need catalog-fit confirmation, streaming latency numbers, security Q answers (BYOK/HSM/residency), and a short POC pricing card. Can we triage?

mz_se: I can own fidelity checks. Do they route lots of short control messages or mostly long transcripts?

joel_sales: Mostly short control messages (15-40 tokens) but they sometimes attach a 1k token system state. Traffic pattern is spiky across many edge agents.

tara_infra: Note: aurorafoil-20b-core in prod catalog uses a hybrid-kv layout (compact for small prefixes, tiled for long contexts). For the q4_2 quant path we should benchmark both layouts.

vikram_sec: Security flags: BYOK required, EU residency option, and they asked whether we run artifact vulnerability scans and can provide an onboarding audit. Hosted POC preferred; Dedicated if HSM required.

anya_prod: For hosted POC we can do KMS passthrough. I'll draft questionnaire wording and a POC template once mode is confirmed.

deploy-bot: Starting ephemeral dev job #12844 for aurorafoil-20b-core (v2.1).

tara_infra: Suggested quick bench (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model aurorafoil-20b-core --variant aurorafoil-20b-q4_2,float16 --quant q4_2 --kv-layout hybrid-kv,compact-kv --seq-dist aurorafoil-seq-mix.json --concurrency 6 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

trara_infra_note: Running tiled and compact passes; will report tail latency and throughput.

tara_infra: Quick results (smoke): short-only p95 float16 ~70ms, q4_2 ~95ms. Mixed (1k spike) p95 float16 ~430ms, q4_2 ~600ms at concurrency 6. hybrid-kv reduced p99 by ~12% versus compact on mixed runs but cost ~8% throughput.

mz_se: Good. I'll prepare a fidelity diff plan — ask AuroraFoil for 45 representative prompts so we can run deterministic comparisons between float16 and q4_2 and highlight divergence cases.

vikram_sec: Draft security snippet: "Hosted POC: customer-managed KMS via key passthrough; logs and data encrypted at rest and in transit; HSM-backed key storage available on Dedicated/Private. Artifact checks: checksum validation and static scans; third-party attestation available as a scoped engagement." I'll attach our last onboarding summary.

anya_prod: Pricing idea: 1-week hosted POC block (discounted token bucket + 4-hour ops support per day) with opt-in Dedicated uplift for HSM. I'll share numbers in a private thread.

joel_sales: Timeline: AuroraFoil demo scheduled Wednesday. Can we deliver bench + sec answers + pricing card by Tuesday EOD?

tara_infra: Action items recap: @mz_se run prompt diffs when prompts arrive; @tara_infra attach full bench logs and recommend mitigations (prefix caching, routing); @vikram_sec finalize questionnaire answers and attach audit docs; @anya_prod prepare 1-page POC price card. Deliver Tue EOD.

deploy-bot: Job #12844 succeeded: aurorafoil-20b-core v2.1 deployed on ephemeral-dev-pool. Logs uploaded.
